title: Accomplishment
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.138 Numbered Discourses 3.138
  • 14. Yodhājīvavagga 14. A Warrior

Sampadāsutta Accomplishment

“Tisso imā, bhikkhave, sampadā. “Mendicants, there are three accomplishments. Katamā tisso? What three? Saddhāsampadā, sīlasampadā, paññāsampadā—Accomplishment in faith, ethics, and wisdom. imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso sampadā”ti. These are the three accomplishments.”

Chaṭṭhaṁ.
